استجنسن (form X)
# اِسْتَجْنَسْنَ (istajnasna) /is.tad͡ʒ.nas.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اُسْتُجْنِسْنَ (ustujnisna) /us.tud͡ʒ.nis.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اِسْتَجْنِسْنَ (istajnisna) /is.tad͡ʒ.nis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
